metadata.evidence_scope: small real-data experiment; does not reproduce CIFAR/ImageNette
metadata.initial_state: untrained; shared runner must train baseline
metadata.preprocessing: fixed division by 16; no fitted statistics

development_test: historical seen test; development data, no independent confirmation claim

checkpoint.reload_scope: strict state_dict reload into compressed architecture template

historical.historical_rng: not archived; new deterministic recovery RNG frozen separately
historical.optimizer_state: not archived in historical series; recovery uses one new Adam from checkpoint0

recovery.latency_after_recovery: none; export/reload smoke only, outside pilot timing claim
recovery.teacher: independent frozen eval baseline; unchanged weight and buffer hash

resources.preflight_scope: conservative300s allowance covers all recorded prefreeze tests, their failed attempts, imports and baseline verification; not measured scientific wall time
resources.scope: all package computational attempts; stages sequential; no cluster

source.normalization: CRLF to LF; includes untracked executed modules and package tests

timing.baseline_spread: report full range of 3 paired-block baseline medians; no final acceleration claim
timing.first_call_scope: first reloaded-graph call after exporter prepared device/context; not cold process/device
timing.micro_control: materialized SAME approximate Conv2 W with same bias; representation control, not compressed budget
timing.passes: synchronized wall forward; CPU-device-CPU full path; CUDA events; separate blocked throughput
timing.unit: 3 paired blocks; 500 calls are within-session observations

transforms.N_selection: lambda0 Conv2 r8 only; select before ridge trials
transforms.N_source: same existing calibration pool, prefix order unchanged
transforms.alpha_selection: at chosenN include lambda0; best nonzero separately determines otherN diagnostics; no reselection from those diagnostics
transforms.joint_controls: 2 protected-first Conv2+ordinary Linear16; 4 first SVD3 original/current graph weighted Conv2 r8 with/without same Linear16
transforms.main_models: only second Conv r8 SVD/selected weighted, each with/without ordinary Linear16; first Conv dense
transforms.nullspace: Linear r8 N90/180 preserve_nullspace, retain unsupported rank-overflow without hidden rank increase
